system.description:
Built on Project FU's Chimerist.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points
  • Ritualism rituals

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Chimerist counterpart.)

VIVISECTIONIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000259]{Spell Mimic} 【Max SL 10】

After a beast, monster or plant you can see resolves a spell, learn it (recording the Species). Hold up to (SL + 2); offensive casts use your chosen (INS + WLP) or (MIG + WLP). Variant available: Spell Buffet — read non-humanoid HP at (15 + half level) or less, execute one to learn all its spells, keeping (SL + 4). Chosen permanently.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000260]{Consume} 【Max SL 5】

After your spell damages one or more creatures, with an arcane, dagger or flail weapon equipped: recover (SL × 2) MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000261]{Feral Speech} 【Max SL 1】

You can always communicate with beasts, monsters and plants.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000262]{Pathogenesis} 【Max SL 1】

Your Chimerist spells poison each damaged creature that shares its Species with the creature you learned the spell from.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000263]{Call the Wild} 【Max SL 3】

Spend 2 IP on food that draws nearby animals to perform a simple task, comparable to a Minor Ritual.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000264]{Trait Mimic} 【Max SL 10】

Record Traits you learn from visible beasts, monsters and plants. Invoke one for 15 MP or 1 Fabula Point to mimic the creature — one impressive feat within that Trait's bounds, statistics unchanged.
